answer: Sybil resistance comes from reputation decaying exponentially with a temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest service to maintain influence. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust graph, a freshly spawned identity has few credible incoming endorsements and near-zero eigenvector centrality; linked accounts cannot bootstrap trust merely by endorsing one another, so the identity cannot pass consensus. Names such as quill, beacon, and quartz do not alter the evidence or trust weights.
